. Goals and Objectives of the Website
One of the major goals of the website is to establish a professional online store where the
customers can conveniently browse through the products available, purchase them, and learn
about the company. The development of the website is expected to assist Letso Luxe in creating
an online presence and getting new clients.
Among the pages that will be used on the website, there will be Home, Shop, About Us, Contact
ers. Customers will have access to the features that allow searching for
products, viewing product descriptions, adding products to the cart and ordering them.
The success of the website will be evaluated based on the following KPIs:
Increase the number of website visitors every month.
Get more client inquiries via the contact page.
Decrease the number of abandoned shopping carts.
